run_empty_message_test: run the EmptyMessageTest unittest suite to verify gRPC empty message handling across all RPC patterns
test_unary_unary_empty: test the unary-unary gRPC call with an empty request and empty response payload
test_unary_stream_empty: test the unary-stream gRPC call that yields multiple empty responses from a single empty request
test_stream_unary_empty: test the stream-unary gRPC call that consumes a stream of empty requests and returns one empty response
test_stream_stream_empty: test the stream-stream gRPC call that yields an empty response for each empty request in the stream
